text:
Elaine (Sales): FYI — Cypress National POC kicked off. They want on-prem SCIM (air-gapped), support for >1 IdP per tenant (Okta + Ping + Azure), domain-level admin delegation, and RBAC mapping to their internal entitlement codes. They also uploaded a 40-page security questionnaire and asked for a first-pass Dedicated+Private quote.
Marco (SE): Thanks. Couple things to confirm before the call: expected user counts? sync cadence? do they expect SCIM to be authoritative or is there a separate HR source? Also do they require SCIM bulk exports for audits?
Elaine (Sales): They said ~200k active users, heavy contractor churn (~15k contractors/month), want 4x daily deltas + JIT on auth for contractors. HR will be authoritative for full profiles but they want SCIM as the operational source for app access. They also need bulk export ability for quarterly audits.
Priya (Infra): Air-gapped SCIM: propose a local SCIM gateway that runs in their network, talks to a Private control plane over a one-way sync channel or via mTLS tunnel. For 200k users + 4x/day, incremental deltas with change tokens + pagination is necessary. Recommend 300 req/s throttle headroom during initial syncs.
Dana (Security): Uploaded the questionnaire bits we need to answer: data residency, key management, cert rotation, vulnerability scanning cadence, and erase-on-decommission. Link: https://redwood-secure/cypress/questionnaire-2026.pdf :page_facing_up:
DeployBot: New questionnaire uploaded by Dana — /cypress/questionnaire-2026.pdf :white_check_mark:
Marco (SE): RBAC mapping idea: use SCIM custom extension for entitlement codes and groups. Example mapping: ````json
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User","urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:cypress:1.0:User"],
  "userName": "j.smith@cypress.com",
  "emails": [{"value": "j.smith@cypress.com","primary": true}],
  "urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:cypress:1.0:User": {"entitlements": ["ENT-GL-1002","ENT-TR-4001"]}
}
````
Marco (SE): For delegated admins: SCIM groups + delegated scopes (user.invite, group.manage, access.review). We'll surface a lightweight admin UI in Private that reads group membership from the gateway. Need to confirm their max group size and whether nested groups are used.
Priya (Infra): Multi-IdP per tenant: we'll store per-IdP metadata and canonicalize attributes using a mapping layer. Must support SAML nameID format persistent & email and OIDC sub/email. Also need a plan for IdP failover (priority list) — think about session affinity.
Dana (Security): On KMS/HSM: we support customer-managed keys for Private; will document KMS integration options and HSM SKIs. Also ask product: what is the default retention for logs & how easily can customers shorten it?
Elaine (Sales): Pricing — very rough first pass to share with buyer: Reserved Dedicated pool = $60k/mo, Private deployment license = $200k one-time, On-site install & validation = $18k one-time, Premium connectors + enterprise SLA = $6k/mo. Call it an order-of-magnitude estimate.
Marco (SE): Technical blockers to flag: bulk SCIM exports (we currently provide CSV export via the gateway), nested groups complexity, very large group cardinality (>50k members), and JIT latencies if connector is overloaded. Need to plan a throttling backoff and retry window.
Priya (Infra): Ops notes: certificate rotation for the gateway — propose 90-day rotation by default, automated via an agent that can pull new certs from our control plane or accept manually uploaded certs. For air-gapped installs, provide a signed cert bundle and rotation script.
Dana (Security): I'll draft questionnaire answers for enclave/network isolation, KMS/HSM, vulnerability scan cadence (we do quarterly + on-major-release), and attestations for SOC2. Need confirmation from Product on erase-on-termination timeline for Private nodes.
Elaine (Sales): Action list: 1) Marco: architecture diagram + SCIM mapping example + note for nested group behavior (due EOD). 2) Priya: cert rotation + gateway install checklist + throughput numbers (due EOD). 3) Dana: initial questionnaire draft + KMS/HSM options (due tomorrow). 4) I'll send the ballpark pricing and book POC kickoff with Cypress for Wed 11:00 PT.
Marco (SE): I'll also prepare a small test dataset (20k users with nested groups) and a runbook to validate delta + JIT for the POC.
Priya (Infra): Will include network diagram and recommended firewall rules (mTLS endpoints, allowed CIDR). Also recommend we ship a preconfigured demo image for the gateway to reduce install time.
Elaine (Sales): Great — thanks everyone. I'll confirm Wed 11:00 PT and share the buyer prework (they need to provision a service account and DNS TXT for domain verification). :spiral_calendar:
